description:
Preview what reaches the destination for a withdrawal — offline, no API call, works without a token.

The JamiDev usage fee (7% unless Jami set a custom rate on the account) and any government tax are cut FROM the amount: you withdraw amount, the account receives net. Rounding is round-half-up per component. The server is authoritative; the real breakdown comes back on the withdrawal.

Args:
  - amount_minor: gross santim (min 10000 = 100.00 ETB).
  - fee_rate / tax_rate: optional overrides (0–1) if you know the account's real rates.

Returns the breakdown plus whether the amount auto-pays (≤ 10,000 ETB) or goes to manual review, and the per-org 100,000 ETB rolling-24h cap.

amount_minor.description: Gross amount in integer santim — the fee is cut from this. 10000 = 100.00 ETB (the minimum).

response_format.description: 'markdown' (default) for a readable summary, 'json' for the full structured payload

name: jami_quote_withdrawal

auto_payout.description: true when ≤ 10,000 ETB — paid out without manual review

title: Quote withdrawal
